evidence.finding: Cavity-coupled MZI and balanced photodetection generate a signed error; model and reference evidence must stay distinct from generated episode outputs.

AIM SOI photonic foundry implementation, high-Q Euler microring, input grating/Y-junction, two heater functions, detector pair and monitor channel support a design-and-fabrication service stage. Exact mask/process inputs are absent.
Chip is packaged; BPD-to-TIA wirebond/interface and PID electronics are described. Physical assembly can be represented by closed-service readiness receipts, not invented real assembly instructions.

Polarization controller, fiber probe/grating interface, attenuator and temperature stabilization appear in the reported setup; safe simulation must include interface/alignment readiness rather than omit this work. No real beam handling instructions.
ECDL chirp, calibrated fiber-MZI frequency reference, ring-monitor and error-signal simultaneous readout support calibration and response-fitting activities.
Three distinct lasers have free-running and closed-loop noise comparisons, with PID path and FPGA in-loop channel. Branch-specific control settings are not reported fully.
Final Methods use stabilized comb-referenced heterodyne beat-note acquisition; represent reference-lock readiness and detector/digitizer service, not a fabricated comb calibration.
Out-of-loop absolute PSD is distinct from in-loop relative-error PSD; record estimator, frequency axis, units, calibration lineage, resolution and integration interval.
Cavity TRN, electronics and shot-noise contributions, area/volume tradeoff, DC/baseband susceptibility and bandwidth limitations are part of design coverage.
Equal-footprint ideal comparison and loss/coupling sweeps are separate modeling tasks, not measurements on the fabricated chip.
Analytic thermal-noise models and reported FEM/COMSOL comparison support a model-input/result interface. Exact solver files, meshes and boundary conditions are unavailable.
The second platform is a numerical estimate only. Its parameters and linewidth reference cannot be relabeled as the demonstrated silicon device.
Earlier self-heterodyne setup and earlier RMS/linewidth values were superseded; final comb-based acquisition and final spectrum/integral values govern this design.
